text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over the past day, with Ethereum showing slightly larger weakness, while the Fear & Greed index sitting at 29 signals genuine market anxiety despite a mild uptick over the week. Bitcoin dominance holding above 56% and total volume at $51B suggest traders are rotating into the largest assets rather than abandoning crypto entirely, a defensive posture typical of uncertainty rather than panic liquidation. The broader altcoin complex (BNB, SOL) is holding relatively steadier than the majors, indicating some capital preservation but not conviction-driven buying.
